debug_enabled.description: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting.

nick_name.description: Public nickname visible to peers (max 20 chars).

webui_enabled.description: Enable the WebUI for remote management (recommended).

kad_enabled.description: Enable the KAD network (decentralized, no central servers required).

ed2k_enabled.description: Enable the eD2k network (connects to public servers).

downloads_dir.description: Directory where completed downloads are stored.

swap_dir.description: Directory for temporary swap/session files (e.g., shared files list).

config_dir.description: Directory where configuration and backups are stored.

log_dir.description: Optional directory for log files. Leave empty to disable file logging.

files_connections.description: Maximum number of connections per file. Set to 0 for automatic tuning.

max_connections.description: Maximum total connections. Use 0 for no limit (but respect system limits).

upload_limit_kb.description: Global upload bandwidth limit in KB/s. 0 means unlimited.

download_limit_kb.description: Global download bandwidth limit in KB/s. 0 means unlimited.

auto_update_servers.description: Automatically fetch and update the list of eD2k servers.

auto_update_server_list.description: Fetch server list from a remote URL (requires ServerURL below).

server_list_url.description: URL to fetch the official server list (used only if auto_update_server_list is enabled).

auto_update_source_list.description: Automatically download and update the list of servers for source exchange.

source_list_url.description: URL to fetch the source list (used only if auto_update_source_list is enabled).

upnp_enabled.description: Enable automatic port forwarding via UPnP/NAT-PMP.

inbound_port_tcp.description: TCP port for incoming eD2k connections (client-to-client).

inbound_port_udp.description: UDP port for incoming KAD connections (DHT).

allow_external.description: Allow remote connections from external hosts (if true, ensure firewall and passwords are configured securely).

admin_password.description: Password for amulecmd and WebUI access. Required for security.

webui_password.description: Optional separate password for WebUI (if omitted, uses admin_password).

webui_port.description: Port for the WebUI HTTP server.

webui_interface.description: Interface the WebUI binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only, '*' for all).

webui_ssl_cert_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format).

remote_interface.description: Interface for amulecmd (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for local only, or '0.0.0.0' for remote).

ed2k_interface.description: Network interface for eD2k TCP connections.

kad_interface.description: Network interface for KAD UDP connections.

log_incoming.description: Log details of incoming connections (increases log volume).

file_buffer_size_kb.description: I/O buffer size for file reads (KB). Larger values improve performance on fast disks.

disk_cache_enabled.description: Enable disk caching for improved I/O throughput.

disk_cache_size_mb.description: Size of disk cache (MB). Adjust based on available RAM.

share_temp.description: Allow sharing of partially downloaded files (enables resumable sources).

connect_to_servers.description: Connect to the last known servers on startup.

auto_reconnect.description: Automatically reconnect if disconnected from servers.

idle_shutdown_minutes.description: Shutdown daemon after N minutes of inactivity. 0 disables auto-shutdown.

shutdown_on_idle.description: Shut down after all downloads complete (e.g., for headless servers).

shutdown_on_exit.description: Shut down system after daemon exits cleanly.

upload_slots.description: Upload slots per file. 0 = automatic based on capacity.

min_share_ratio.description: Minimum share ratio to stop seeding (e.g., 1.0 = upload same as download). 0 = no minimum.

max_share_ratio.description: Maximum share ratio to stop seeding (e.g., 1.0). 0 = unlimited.

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable IPv6 support (required for full Kad functionality).

ipv4_preferred.description: If IPv6 is enabled, prefer IPv4 connections (for compatibility).

kad_nodes_cache.description: Cache Kad nodes for faster startup (requires KadNodesCacheFile path).

kad_nodes_cache_file.description: Optional path to Kad nodes cache file. If omitted, uses default location.

throttle_enabled.description: Enable throttling to limit bandwidth usage (e.g., to avoid saturating link).

upload_throttle_kb.description: Upload throttle during download (KB/s, 0 = no throttle).

schedule_enabled.description: Enable time-based bandwidth throttling (e.g., off-peak limits).

min_server_version.description: Minimum server version required (e.g., '0.26' for eMule 0.26a).

max_server_version.description: Maximum server version allowed. Use 9999 to allow any version.

min_server_upload_kb.description: Minimum upload speed (KB/s) required to add a server.

min_server_download_kb.description: Minimum download speed (KB/s) required to add a server.

min_users_on_server.description: Minimum number of users required to connect to a server.

min_files_on_server.description: Minimum number of files required to connect to a server.

trusted_servers.description: List of trusted servers (format: 'IP:Port'). Used even if server list is stale or unresponsive.

blocked_servers.description: List of blocked servers (format: 'IP:Port'). Will never connect to these.

items.description: Server IP and port to block (e.g., '10.0.0.1:4662').

always_connect.description: List of servers to always attempt connecting to (e.g., your own internal servers).

ip_filter_enabled.description: Enable IP-based filtering using a rules file (e.g., to block malicious IPs).

ip_filter_file.description: Path to the IP filter rules file (e.g., from www.ip2location.com or similar).

auto_ip_filter.description: Automatically download and apply IP filter lists.

crypto_required.description: Require encrypted connections (e.g., via SSL) to eD2k servers and peers (preferred).

kad_crypto_required.description: Require encryption for Kad (UDP) communication (modern clients only).

stats_enabled.description: Enable internal statistics (used for health monitoring only).
